# Metric attribution

OpenFactsheet seeks to credit the people who originated each measure it reports. This page lists, for every canonical metric, the originator(s) where that is reliably established, the seminal work, and how certain the attribution is. It is generated from the metric registry (`src/openfactsheet/metrics/attribution.py` and each metric's references), so every registered metric appears here.

- **Bacon as a secondary reference.** Carl R. Bacon's *Practical Risk-Adjusted Performance Measurement* (2nd ed., Wiley; dated 2021 in the registry, some catalogues list 2022) documents many of these measures. It is credited as a secondary reference where the registry cites it, not as the originator of the measures it describes.
- **Exact definitions.** Each metric's page in the [metric catalog](metric_catalog.md) gives the full citations, the exact formula OpenFactsheet implements and the convention chosen where definitions differ.
- **Attribution is not endorsement.** Naming an author, a book, a firm or a library is not an endorsement, affiliation, license grant, or permission to reproduce protected content. Formulas are implemented independently from their published mathematical definitions; no text, tables or figures of the cited works are reproduced.
- **Corrections.** If an attribution, citation, copyright notice or license is incomplete or wrong, please open an issue at <https://github.com/bagnascotrader/openfactsheet/issues> with the source that supports the correction. Report security vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), never in a public issue.

## Attribution status

| Status | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- |
| established | The originator and seminal work are well documented in the literature. |
| attributed | Commonly attributed to the named originator(s), but the primary source, its date or the exact original definition is not fully verified. |
| convention | A standard statistic or practitioner convention with no single originator. |
| uncertain | The originator is not reliably established; the entry names where the measure is documented instead. |
| pending | No curated attribution yet; the registry's references are listed. |
